newsitem.title: USA: Aon brokerage/consulting segment up in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Aon brokerage/consulting segment up in Q3.

text.p: Aon Corp said Tuesday third quarter revenues for its insurance brokerage and consulting services segment rose 12.2 percent to $471.4 million from $420.2 million last year.
Pretax operating income for this segment increased 21.6 percent to $55.7 million, due in part to acquisitions.
Aon's insurance underwriting revenues rose 7.3 percent to $443 million, while pretax operating income increased eight percent to $70.4 million from $65.2 million a year ago.

Earlier, Aon reported third quarter earnings from continuing operations excluding investment gains of $0.70 a share, up from $0.61 a year ago. Net earnings were $0.72 a share, compared with $0.87 a year ago.

"Results for the third quarter reflected solid contributions from Aon's major lines of business -- insurance brokerage and consulting services and insurance underwriting," Patrick Ryan, chairman, said in a statement.
The insurance underwriting results were led by growth of extended warranty businesses, which continue to gain market share both on a domestic and international basis, he added.
